tlP: Phones give the tilt sensor only over a secure connection, so the pad opens again over https.
tl1: The browser will say “Your connection is not private”: it is your own TV, that is fine, and only the first time.
tl2i: Tap “Show Details”, then “visit this website”, then “Visit Website”.
tl3a: The pad opens again in your same seat: tilt the phone to aim.
tl3i: The pad opens again in your same seat: tap “Turn on tilt” again and choose Allow.
rch: No TV in sight? If the TV changed network or address, scan its QR code again.
rs: Scan the QR code on the TV again
rsh: The connection code was changed. Scan the new one to join again.
phg: Tilt the phone or drag a finger to aim
rp: The pad is open in another browser or tab
kk: The TV sent you out of the room
t: Add to Home Screen to play fullscreen
s1: Tap Safari’s Share button (the square with an up arrow)
s3: Open the pad from the new icon: fullscreen
sp: This game takes {n} players at most: you are watching
lb: Lobby: try the buttons, then tap Ready
aw: TV Games is not open on the TV
awh: The buttons do nothing right now.
awr: Open TV Games with the TV remote
cs: TV Games was closed on the TV
csh: Open TV Games on the TV again; this phone joins back by itself.
aP: Pick game files (NES .nes or arcade .zip, up to 64 MB each). They show up on the TV as soon as they are uploaded.
aP2: Paste the address of a game that runs in a browser (https, or http on your home network). You play it with this controller.
aWbad: Not a valid link (needs http:// or https://)
